proposal.reason: Primary change is CI/test orchestration: a new experimental daily workflow, artifact download retry action, NAS cache/group staging and reconciliation scripts, and expanded xtest datasets/contracts (including the patch-omitted 8,900-line daily full CSV) for case selection/execution coverage. These are substantive open-source test workflow and runner-path changes, while build/script/docs edits are supporting this CI behavior rather than independent core PCCL module changes.
